name: El Real de la Jara (Spain)
description: Green field crossed by a white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Real de la Jara (a castle and a cross, with the motto ES REAL POR SU LEALTAD).
history: The town council of El Real de la Jara had no vexillological precedent and proceeded to adopt the flag that was to represent it from then on, choosing as usual colours from its arms: a rectangular flag 1.80 m long and 1.30 m high, green, crossed diagonally by a white band.
